fields.subject: Core Log Events
fields.trigger: code elsewhere in the library invokes the extension method TraceDbCmdExecuted(this ILogger logger, string commandName, string connectionName, long milliseconds), TraceShardCmdExecuted(this ILogger logger, string commandName, string shardSetKey, short shardId, long milliseconds), or BuildSqlResultsHandlerScope(this ILogger logger, string procedureName, Type model); LoggerExtensions.cs defines only these wrapper members and does not establish when or why a caller invokes them
fields.response: TraceDbCmdExecuted and TraceShardCmdExecuted each check logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace) and, only when Trace is enabled, invoke their compiled Trace-level delegate, logging the command name, connection or shard-set/shard identifiers, and elapsed milliseconds under event id CmdExecuted (8). BuildSqlResultsHandlerScope opens a disposable logging scope, compiled via LoggerMessage.DefineScope, carrying the stored-procedure name and result-model Type, until the caller disposes it.
